newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET - RUTHERFORD CENTURY SETS UP TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - RUTHERFORD CENTURY SETS UP TRANSVAAL.

text.p: A brilliant century from just 88 balls by Transvaal captain Ken Rutherford set his side up for victory against Western Province on the third day of the Supersport Series match at the Wanderers.

Rutherford hit 126 not out in the Transvaal second innings of 263 for eight declared and when rain brought an early close Province were struggling at 59 for two, still needing an unlikely 349 to reach the victory target of 408.
Rutherford's innings was the difference between the two sides as he hauled Transvaal back into the ascendancy with some audacious hitting.
At lunch Transvaal were struggling at 98 for five, but Rutherford blasted his way from 17 to 126 in the afternoon session before declaring at the tea interval.

In all the New Zealander hit 20 fours and two sixes from 109 balls. He got good support from Nic Pothas in a sixth wicket stand of 130, but the wicket-keeper was totally overshadowed by Rutherford's strokeplay.
When Province batted again Desmond Haynes was trapped lbw for three by Rowan Lyle and the tall paceman had Sven Koenig caught at short leg to reduce the visitors to 24 for two.
The rain reduced the day by 26 overs, but with an early start on the last day Transvaal will be hot favourites to wrap up the match and rejoin the contenders for the title at the top of the log.
